verdicts.title: Superhalogens as Building Blocks of Complex Hydrides for Hydrogen Storage
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Superhalogens are species whose electron affinity (EA) or vertical detachment energy (VDE) exceed to those of halogen. These species typically consist of a central electropositive atom with electronegative ligands.
